resources.string: Lets Jarvis read the Hearthpane screen you are on, point at its controls, control your home through the Control Center and keep personal and household reminders.

[{\"name\":\"hearthpane.screen_context\",\"description\":\"Describe the Hearthpane screen in front of the user as structured text (Control Center rooms and devices, Music now playing with its play controls and queue, the Settings page and its rows, Calls rooms with their Video call buttons). No pixels or photos. Call it when the user asks what is on their screen or how to do something on it. Results carry target ids for hearthpane.highlight.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"query\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"For how-do-I questions: a few words of the setting the user wants, e.g. dark mode. Adds the matching Settings rows from anywhere, with where they are.\"}}}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.highlight\",\"description\":\"Pulse one control on the Hearthpane screen in front so the user can see it. Use a target id from hearthpane.screen_context, then tell the user what to do with it.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"target\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A target id from hearthpane.screen_context, e.g. settings:immortal.settingsTheme, cc.room.kitchen, music.controls or a room\'s video_call_target.\"},\"hint\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A few words shown beside the control, e.g. Tap the switch.\"}},\"required\":[\"target\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.home_control\",\"description\":\"Control the user\'s home through Hearthpane\'s Control Center: lights, switches, fans, locks, the garage door, blinds, the water valve, thermostats, the alarm and Home Assistant scenes, by room, floor or device name. Call it for any request to change something in the house, e.g. turn off the kitchen lights, dim the living room to 30 percent, lock the front door, set the heating to 70, run Good night. Locking, lights and the like happen at once. Unlocking, the garage, the water valve, the alarm and some scenes are never done by voice: the result has needs_confirmation and Hearthpane shows its own confirm sheet on the Portal\'s screen, so tell the user to tap it there and do not call again or claim it is done. Answer with the result text, briefly; if it asks which room or device, ask the user.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"request\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"The user\'s request in their own words, e.g. turn off the kitchen lights.\"}},\"required\":[\"request\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.reminders\",\"description\":\"Personal and household reminders on the Portal. action add: remember something, e.g. remind me to call mom at 6 (for = me), remind Arjun to pay the bill tomorrow at 9, remind everyone to take the bins out. action list: what reminders someone has (for = me or a name) or the household\'s. action complete: tick one off by its title words or id. me is the person Hearthpane recognises on its Home right now; if the result has needs_person, ask the user who it is for and call again with their name or household. Private reminders are never read out: a list gives only their count. Answer with the result message, briefly.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add, list or complete.\"},\"title\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add: what to remember, short, without the time, e.g. call mom. complete: the words the user used for it.\"},\"for\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"Who it is for: me, a person\'s name, or household. Leave out for the household.\"},\"time\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add: due time in 24-hour form, e.g. 18:00 (at 6 in the evening is 18:00). Leave out for no time.\"},\"date\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add: due date YYYY-MM-DD when it is not the next time that clock time comes round, e.g. for tomorrow morning.\"},\"private\":{\"type\":\"BOOLEAN\",\"description\":\"add: false if the user wants others to see it. Defaults to private for adults.\"},\"id\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"complete: a reminder id from list.\"}},\"required\":[\"action\"]}}]
